Stand-up comedian criticizes TV show, calls host 'privileged'

Abhijit Dipke, founder of the 'Cockroach Janata Party', stated he dislikes the TV show 'India's Got Latent' and would not participate even if offered. He expressed these views during an interview with host Samay Raina, whom he also described as 'privileged'. The discussion touched upon stand-up comedy and preferred comedians.
